limitations: Pilot contains only 16 train, 8 validation and 8 test source campaigns.
Training has two elite fights; validation lacks an Underdocks elite.
Starts are conditioned on the fixed 500k collector reaching them; decks and HP are not optimized counterfactuals.
Both existing models win 64/65 ordinary fights and 1/7 bosses on this small validation sample; this does not isolate policy skill from starting inventory quality.
Only eight imitation updates and 512 PPO decisions were run for integration; no playing-strength improvement or checkpoint promotion is claimed.
The two hybrid integration games both end in defeat; their purpose is routing/recording validation.
Timing phases overlap and are not a controlled throughput benchmark.
Implementation and release-preparation elapsed times were not separately measured; no release or push was performed.
scope: Campaign-derived frozen Act 1 combat corpus, train-only PPO, matched combat benchmark, existing hybrid integration.

verification.method: Restore each frozen start; execute every recorded candidate ref directly through a fresh HeadlessAdapter, independently of Gym slot mapping; compare exact public successors and execution reports. Combat completion uses the declared combat task boundary.

inspector.limitation: Viewer retains canonical outcomes: a combat victory usually appears as Cutoff / external stop. Combat win rates are in combat-benchmark.json. No private snapshots or seeds are copied into inspection inputs.

regeneration.interpretation: Replaces affected combat demonstrations/comparison and the small combat warm-up/PPO smoke. Same frozen game states and existing Act 1 checkpoints. New case IDs imply new case-derived random-legal policy RNG; this is not a same-policy-RNG comparison with the invalid report. Phase timings overlap. The 512-decision model is an integration check, not a promoted stronger policy.
